role: Accessibility reviewer, round two (an AI reviewer, not a user study; no real screen reader was run, so speech is INFERRED from Chromium's AX tree)
environment: Simulated host only. I served proto-R, then my copy of it (C:\Users\stephen\AppData\Local\Temp\hw-tfa-a11y\proto-Rfix), d04 for one baseline check. Served with C:\Users\stephen\git\hwinfo-pi-density\scripts\lib\pi-sim.mjs (PI_SIM_PLUGIN_DIR) and driven through headless Chrome with scripts/lib/cdp.mjs under npx tsx. Ports 34220 to 34228 only. Widths and DPR: 373x410 and 320x410 at DPR 1.5. For 200% zoom, 189x205 and 160x205 at DPR 3 (2 x 1.5), plus 410-tall variants. Chromium's AX tree came from CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree and getPartialAXTree. Pointer and key input were real CDP Input events. Forced colors (dark) and reduced motion were set with Emulation.setEmulatedMedia, and I injected the WCAG 1.4.12 text-spacing override. For the late-fold-answer test I delayed only the plugin's panelFolds reply (900 ms) by wrapping ws send. Scripts are in C:\Users\stephen\AppData\Local\Temp\hw-tfa-a11y: probe.mjs, extra.mjs, note.mjs, ts373.mjs, ofx.mjs. Results are in out\R, out\R-C, out\R-G, out\R-DE, out\R-extra, out\Rfix-C, out\Rfix-extra, with PNGs. Caveats: (1) the hwinfo-pi-density worktree has uncommitted edits, so the sim's plugin side (src/*.ts) is the live worktree while the panels are the prototype copies. (2) The sim keeps the last applied shared theme when a fixture has empty globals, so key-empty and dial-empty sometimes read '(shared: Paper)' or '(shared: Ultraviolet)'. That is a sim artifact, not an R defect. (3) This is not the app's QtWebEngine.
summary:
R fixes every accessibility problem I raised in round one at the app's real sizes, but one near miss is left at 200% zoom. That one needs a one-line fix.

What works (MEASURED):
- **Name and state:** the fold row is a native disclosure (DisclosureTriangle). Its accessible name equals its visible words, open and folded, in 12 states at 373 and 160 and for all eight chips. Only the expanded state changes. Examples: 'Theme Default (shared: Void)', 'Theme Ember (set on this dial)', 'Theme "synthwave-sunset-2027" (unknown; draws Void)'.
- **Empty key:** folded, the name adds 'Shows on the key once a reading is picked.' It drops the sentence once a reading arrives, and it never appears on a dial or when the band is open.
- **Radiogroup:** it keeps name 'Theme' and its description, and the description is no longer read twice (AT06).
- **Change at 373 and 320:** Change sits outside the row with a 13.5 px dead gap. The row's inset ring (0..305) never touches Change (318.5). Change's own ring is never clipped. 0 of 29 near-miss presses fold the band.
- **Tab order:** open it is toolbar, row, Change, checked chip, Reading. Folded it is row, then Reading.
- **Text spacing (1.4.12):** no overlap at 373, 320, 189 or 160.
- **Forced colors:** the triangle is CanvasText, the ring is visible and the chips keep their real colors, Paper included.
- **Reduced motion:** nothing in the band moves (only the 0.12 s triangle turn, and it drops to none).
- **Late fold answer:** it no longer folds a section that holds focus. With focus on the row, Change, a chip, or Reading (also remembered folded), focus is kept and that section stays open. A prompt answer still applies before the first paint (hw-folds-answer at 21 ms).
- **Fold all, Open all and Alt-click** include the band, and the shell announces 'All sections folded'.

What breaks (MEASURED):
- At 189 and 160 (DPR 3), Change sits 2 px under the fold row's box. The row's reserved second line is blank, so the blank strip just above Change is the fold target.
- Presses 2 to 6 px above Change, and 2 px diagonally above, fold the band: 7 of 29 near misses.
- This fails the blocking tests of PT01 and the adversarial reviewer's AT01 at zoom.
- verify.mjs did not catch it: it tests only 2 px above, at DPR 2 on a 410 px viewport.
- A 4 px top margin on Change under 300 px fixes it (A1R01, tested in my copy). Presses 1 to 5 px above then stay clear, the open band grows 4 px (247.6 to 251.6), picks still move nothing and Tab order is unchanged.

Other findings:
- **A1R02 (non-blocking):** folded, a key with no reading plus an unknown stored theme loses the empty-key sentence.
- **Accepted deviation:** the 57 to 60 px open row at 160 (two reserved lines instead of my round-one 42 px target). The name now gets the full width, is never more than two lines for a known theme, and picks never move the chips.
- **My non-blocking round-one items:** AT03 is met by the other reviewer's route (the name comes from the visible chip word and equals the line). AT04, AT05 and AT06 are resolved.
- **Pre-existing, not R's:** a 6 px sideways overflow on the dial panel at 160 px under text spacing (d04 is identical). A press 4 px or more under Change at 373 picks the chip below it (Change is 44.5 x 24.8, so 2.5.8 is met).

round_one_blockers.id: a11y AT01 (Change outside the row, ring, near misses at 373/320)
round_one_blockers.evidence:
MEASURED:
- Row right edge 305 vs Change left 318.5 at 373, and 252 vs 265.5 at 320 (13.5 px gap).
- 0 of 29 real presses at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 px on each side, the 2 px diagonals, 8 px left and mid-gap fold the band.
- The row's focus ring is inset (offset -2) and covers 0..305. Captures: out\R\B-373-summary-focus-open.png and B-320.
- Change's ring (offset 1) is clipped by nothing.
- Tab order: row, Change, checked chip.
- Pressing Change opens Shared defaults and leaves the band open (verify.json).

round_one_blockers.id: a11y AT02 (zoom: Change leaves the row, name not squeezed)
round_one_blockers.evidence:
MEASURED at 189 and 160, DPR 3:
- Change's box never intersects the row and never overlaps the name.
- scrollWidth equals clientWidth in every state.
- Tab order is unchanged.
- No overlap under 1.4.12 text spacing.

The row is 59.8 px, not the 42 px I proposed. I accept that deliberate deviation: two reserved lines keep the chips still across all 8 picks (chip top one value per width) and hold 'Default (shared: Ultraviolet)'. The unknown 'neon' row is 59.8 px (my limit was 60).

This layout leaves one gap: the near miss above Change, tracked as A1R01.

round_one_blockers.id: adversarial AT02 (empty-key note on the folded row)
round_one_blockers.evidence:
MEASURED:

- The same holds when the band is folded from memory of a configured key.
- Configured keys, dials, dial-empty and an unknown theme on a configured key show no note.
- Open, the note is not rendered.

MEASURED: the fact is on the folded row and in the name, as above. It uses the existing help sentence rather than the proposed '· shows once a reading is picked' (no new copy, per adversarial AT02).

Not met:
- The prototype still matches on the help text and needs a checked chip, which BT02 said production must not do.
- On a key with no reading and an unknown stored theme, the folded name is 'Theme "neon" (unknown; draws Void)' with no note.
- Fix: A1R02.

round_one_blockers.id: visual VT01 (Theme styled as a section title)
round_one_blockers.evidence:
MEASURED (verify.json): 13px, weight 600, rgb(236,236,236), at x 28, equal to Reading at 373 and 320.

READ: no zoom rule overrides it. INFERRED from the 160 captures: it lines up with Reading.

MEASURED for all eight chips:

- At 160: 24 px tall and 64 to 68.2 px wide.

MEASURED, folded: the chip sits on row 1 beside the title and the band is 47.8 px (limit 50), so that part passes.

Open: R follows my AT02 layout (Change on its own line under the name) instead of Change beside the title. The open band is 247.6 px at 189 and 160, over VT06's limit of d04 + 8.

From an accessibility view I support R's choice, because Change stays out of the row's box and ring. The height cost is the visual reviewer's call.

MEASURED: #theme-current is never clipped:
- In all 24 state and width checks, open and folded.
- For 'synthwave-sunset-2027' at 373, 320, 189 and 160, including under 1.4.12.
- The AX name holds the whole string with 'draws Void'.

round_one_blockers.evidence:
READ: this belongs to the implementation stage. verify.mjs is a prototype acceptance run, not a product suite. Its near-miss set also misses the zoom top edge that fails at DPR 3 (see PT01).

The port should use A1R01's near-miss points and the AX checks in probe.mjs section A.

changes.change: At 200% zoom, leave dead space between the fold row and Change. In proto-R.css, inside @media (max-width: 299px), change details.hw-look-fold .hw-look-change from 'margin: 0 -2px 2px auto' to 'margin: 4px -2px 2px auto'. That gives a 6 px gap: the row's 2 px top padding plus 4 px. It costs 4 px of open band height at zoom (247.6 to 251.6). Nothing else changes: DOM order, Tab order, Change's 44.5 x 24.8 box, and Change keeping its place while hidden on an explicit pick. I tested it in C:\Users\stephen\AppData\Local\Temp\hw-tfa-a11y\proto-Rfix. Also add these near-miss points to verify.mjs step 2 and to the PT04 port: 3 and 5 px above Change at DPR 3 on a 205 px tall viewport, with Change scrolled into view.
changes.why: MEASURED at 189 and 160 (DPR 3), R leaves Change 2 px under the fold row's box, and the row's reserved second line is blank. A press 2 to 6 px above Change, or 2 px diagonally above, folds the whole band: 7 of 29 presses. The chips vanish and the band shrinks from 248 to 48 px. That fails the blocking acceptance tests of PT01 and the adversarial reviewer's AT01 at the zoom widths. It is the same costly near miss that round one removed at 373, now on the one side where it remains, and it hits exactly the low-vision, zoomed users whose pointing is least precise. WCAG 2.5.8 is met by Change's size, so this is a defect in use, not a conformance failure.
changes.acceptance_test:
Setup: 189x205 and 160x205 at DPR 3, key Default, band open, Change scrolled into view.
1. Change's top minus the row's bottom is at least 6 px (fix: 6, R: 2).
2. Real presses 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 px above Change, and 2 px diagonally above-left and above-right, leave #sec-theme open. In my copy, only a press exactly 6 px above (the row's own edge) folds; R folds on 7 of those points.
3. A press 1 px inside Change's top edge opens Shared defaults.
4. Eight picks at 189 and 160 on a key and on a dial keep one chip top and one Change top per width (fix: yes).
5. Tab order stays toolbar, row, Change, checked chip.
6. scrollWidth equals clientWidth.
7. Open band height at 189 and 160 is at most 252 px.

changes.change: Show the empty-key sentence whatever theme is stored. In proto.js, drop 'chip !== null &&' from the note condition, so it reads: const text = /^Shows on the key/.test(help.textContent) ? help.textContent : "". In production, draw the note from renderThemeHelp's own test (!configured && kind === "key"), not from the help text or a checked chip. The unknown-theme help still never reaches the row, because on a configured key that help does not start with 'Shows on the key'.
changes.why: MEASURED: on a key with no reading and an unknown stored theme, R's folded row and name read 'Theme "neon" (unknown; draws Void)'. The fact that the key still shows the black prompt is inside the fold, so neither sighted users nor assistive tech get it. renderThemeHelp puts the empty-key sentence ahead of the unknown sentence, so the prototype's chip test drops it.
changes.acceptance_test:
All cases folded:
1. A key with no reading and stored theme 'neon': the AX name is 'Theme "neon" (unknown; draws Void) Shows on the key once a reading is picked.' (my copy MEASURED this; R omits the sentence).
2. A configured key with 'neon': the name stays 'Theme "neon" (unknown; draws Void)' and the band is 31 px at 373.
3. dial-empty: no note.
4. Key-empty with Default or Ember: unchanged ('... Shows on the key once a reading is picked.', 47.1 px at 373).

keep: Native details and summary for the fold. MEASURED: role DisclosureTriangle, native expanded state, Enter folds and Space opens, and the focus stays on the row.

The row's accessible name equals its visible words, open and folded, and does not change on fold. MEASURED for 12 states at 373 and 160 and for all eight chips. The cloned chip word gives the folded name ('Default'), its link glyph stays aria-hidden, and the result matches the open line.
Open at 373 and 320, the row ends 13.5 px before Change. Its inset ring never touches Change, its hover fill stops short of Change, and Change's own ring is never clipped.
Under 300 px, Change sits on its own right-aligned line under the row. Visual order matches DOM order: row, Change, chips.
The hidden #theme-desc still describes the radiogroup ('Follows the shared theme, now Void.') and is no longer duplicated as page text (MEASURED: 0 duplicates).
The empty-key sentence is in the folded row's name only while folded, only on keys, and leaves once a reading arrives. #sec-reading moves 0 px when it leaves.
The shell change: a late fold answer never folds a section that holds focus. A prompt answer still applies before the first paint (MEASURED: hw-folds-answer at 21 ms, band folded at reveal).
The band is included in Fold all, Open all and Alt-click, with the 'All sections folded' announcement (MEASURED).
forced-color-adjust: none on the chip faces, including the mini chip, and the CanvasText triangle. Paper's light face stays distinct on the dark panel in forced colors (MEASURED rgb(233,230,222)).
No new motion: with reduced motion, nothing in the band has a transition or animation (MEASURED).
The mini chip's width: auto. Under 1.4.12 text spacing it grows to 77.9 px and the word stays inside the face.
